artifacts.summary: 4-phase plan executing only what the survey concluded remains: resolve the three provisional graph edges against the now-landed sibling reports, create exactly the two justified task entries, and record the cross-repository hand-off by fully-qualified declaration name. No Lean, no other task's territory, no paired-repository edit.

next_steps: Run /implement 700 to execute the plan. Phase 1 is a read-only edge re-check that may adjust the two proposals before Phase 2 creates them; Phase 2 must hold specs/.scope-lock via task-lock.sh scope-acquire because task 698 declares specs/state.json and is a concurrent sibling.

key_plan_decisions.edge_recheck_before_creation: Phase 1 resolves E2/E5/E8 against 695's, 698's and 699's now-landed reports BEFORE any task entry is created, so the re-check can still change the proposals. 699 Part A's finding that 696's redesign relocates rather than repairs the collapse is the concrete reason this is not a formality.
key_plan_decisions.declaration_name_correction: The survey's hand-off item 1 named FormalSystem.Semantics.plusValidZTime_iff_plusValidInt 'confirm on landing'; 695's landed probe proves it under namespace FormalSystem.PlusLanguage. Phase 1 corrects it, since a wrong namespace defeats the point of naming the hand-off by declaration.
key_plan_decisions.f7_consumer_reassigned: 698's landed report declines to widen any task's file_scope by inference, so the F7 nine-file table's consumer is 696's PLAN phase via scripts/plan-file-scope-harvest.sh, not task 698. Handed off by note; no other task's entry is edited.
key_plan_decisions.two_entries_exactly: lplus_compression_and_completeness (deps [695, 696]) and certificate_non_vacuity_and_shape_gates (deps [696, entry A]), the second edge auto-derived from shared-gate file overlap per the multi-task-creation standard's Component 4a. No third task: the general-consequence form stays parallel, and 699 owns the trans_refl follow-on.
key_plan_decisions.non_interactive_creation: Component 7's interactive confirmation cannot surface from a background dispatch; the task description pre-authorizes creation and /orchestrate has no confirmation gates, so creation is non-interactive with the confirmation summary table preserved in the hand-off note for audit.
key_plan_decisions.state_json_concurrency: Task 698 declares specs/state.json and is a concurrent sibling, so Phase 2 brackets the write with task-lock.sh scope-acquire/scope-release, re-reads next_project_number inside the mutex, appends additively with jq '+=', and commits an explicit two-path list.
